fields.name: blue_deposited
fields.description: Initialize to zero if incoming memory is empty. Otherwise start from the incoming integer. Recognize a completed blue deposit from the combined execution-interval evidence: a blue cube is held during transport toward the bin's elevated release pose, the fingers open there, and the gripper withdraws empty, with no observed evidence that the carried cube fell outside the bin. Direct visibility of entry into the opaque bin or disappearance of the released cube is not required. Override the completed transport-release-empty-withdrawal pattern only with affirmative evidence that the carried cube fell or settled outside the bin. An unheld cube newly visible near the release region is not by itself such evidence: image proximity and lack of a held label do not establish the carried cube's identity or a tabletop landing. Do not identify a remaining nearby blue cube as the released cube solely by image proximity; use its earlier presence and the carried cube's motion within this interval to distinguish them. Increment once per such completed deposit in this interval. Use the held cube's color before release; do not count pickup, issuing B, repeated post-release frames, or unrelated cubes appearing or disappearing. Elevated wrist coordinates need not equal the bin's visible center. Preserve if no blue deposit is observed. e.g. 1
